posts.title: Noise
posts.description: To simulate a real behavior requires some level of randomness or noise in the signal. In my case I want to simulate the behaviour of a helm at sea. They try to steer in to a bearing but environmental factors ensure that they wont accurately. Waves, wind, distractions, lack of sleep all play a factor. To simulate this randomness is not enough. A random number between 0 and 1.0 is completely random
